role: One post-open complete-sequence gate for a deterministic two-color detector-row additive-Schwarz correction appended to the independently sealed v258 endpoint. It is not a retuning of the closed single-half-ray route, a selector, training, a resource test, an external gate or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can using both complementary detector checkerboards in one synchronous additive update close the mixed selected/complement observation deficit on all 13x33 opened Case 19 cells, while retaining no more forward work and one fewer exact adjoint than K16, and while outperforming a same-work full-row normal line-search control?
physical_hypothesis: v266 rejects pure spillover and finds both complement-only and two-sided deficits. The missing structure may therefore be simultaneous row-block relaxation rather than another one-sided mask. Two disjoint checkerboards each form a geometry-Jacobi-preconditioned exact normal direction and its own local least-squares coefficient from the same parent residual; both corrections are added synchronously so every ray participates exactly once.
design_evidence_boundary: Only the already opened and independently sealed v265.1 and v266 results may motivate this post-open mechanism. No v267 partial normal, coefficient, candidate field, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol, core, runner, validator and synthetic tests are committed. Synthetic tests may not read Case 19.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: Reuse the exact canonical nine-camera roster and ordering sealed by v265.1 for every rig and frame.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth is forbidden until both new prediction arms and their deployment-visible states are sealed. It is then read only to score field and gradient veto metrics; it never enters either correction, coefficient, control, fallback or stopping.

unique_primary.name: two_color_quincunx_additive_schwarz
unique_primary.parent: Use the formal or independent recreated-v258 field, exact residual, observation and positive geometry-Jacobi inverse from the corresponding sealed v265.1 prediction tree. The inherited ledger is 15A+14A^T.
unique_primary.partition: For every camera and both signed detector components, color 0 contains zero-based detector rays with (u+v) mod 2=0 and color 1 contains the exact complement. Each color has 1152/2304 rays; their sorted union is every ray exactly once. Camera identity, values, truth, frame, rig and metrics do not affect the partition.
unique_primary.color_directions: For each color c independently compute n_c=A_c^T r_c and d_c=M^{-1}n_c using the exact reported-geometry partial adjoint and the sealed geometry-Jacobi inverse.
unique_primary.color_coefficients: For each color independently compute q_c=A_c d_c and alpha_c=<q_c,r_c>/<q_c,q_c>. Both finite numerators and denominators must be strictly above 1e-30 and alpha_c must be positive. There is no cross-color Gram solve, damping, clipping, order, fallback or search.
unique_primary.synchronous_candidate: x_candidate=x_v258+alpha_0*d_0+alpha_1*d_1. Both color updates are computed from the unchanged parent residual and added synchronously; neither sees the other update.

same_work_classical_control.name: full_row_preconditioned_normal_line_search
same_work_classical_control.definition: From the same recreated-v258 parent, compute n=A^T r, d=M^{-1}n, q=Ad and alpha=<q,r>/<q,q>, then x=x_v258+alpha*d. It uses the full observation, one full adjoint and one full forward, has no block partition, and has the same 16A+15A^T ledger as the primary.

accuracy_contract.two_replica_envelope: For both new arms and inherited controls use the componentwise maximum of formal and independent metrics. For K16 use the componentwise minimum. Evaluate every absolute and matched cell, rig p90 and rig worst gate on this conservative envelope.
accuracy_contract.control_dominance: If the same-work full-row control or any inherited equal-or-cheaper control passes every absolute and matched cell and complete-rig tail gate, the two-color partition advantage is not isolated.

forbidden_search: No parity origin, phase, color order, ray fraction, camera/component subset, cross-color Gram term, sequential update, alpha multiplier, clipping, damping, ridge, preconditioner, parent, depth, endpoint blend, threshold, fallback, metric gate, frame subset or rig subset may change after freeze. Do not rescue with a selector, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.

independent_validation.formal_implementation: Torch vectorized exact partial stencils through the frozen v264 operator wrapper, plus the existing exact NumPy full operator for the same-work control and offline physical replay.
independent_validation.independent_implementation: A separate program must use NumPy finite differences, explicit trilinear gathers, numpy.add.at partial adjoints and scalar math.fsum reductions. It must not import the v267 core or runner.
independent_validation.replica_rule: Formal reads only the sealed formal v265.1 parent prediction tree; independent reads only the sealed independent v265.1 parent prediction tree. The independent program seals all new prediction arrays before reading formal v267 arrays or any truth metric.

decision_order: Any protocol, source, parent, motivation, prediction-tree, shape, finite, partition, partial-adjoint, local least-squares, full-row control, physical replay, camera-permutation, call-ledger, independent-state or scoring closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_TWO_COLOR_ADDITIVE_SCHWARZ_V267.

If the unique primary fails any absolute or K16-matched conservative-envelope cell or complete-rig tail gate, conclude FAIL_CASE19_TWO_COLOR_ADDITIVE_SCHWARZ_V267 and close this exact synchronous two-color detector-row mechanism.
If the primary passes but the same-work full-row control or an inherited equal-or-cheaper control also passes, conclude PASS_CASE19_TWO_COLOR_BUT_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V267.

Only if the primary passes all 429 cells and 13 complete rigs, every equal-or-cheaper control remains incomplete, and independent validation passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_TWO_COLOR_ADDITIVE_SCHWARZ_HEADROOM_V267. This is equal-forward/lower-adjoint post-open mechanism headroom only; it does not authorize a predictor, wall/RSS, external or real-BOST claim.
failure_action: Close the synchronous even/odd detector-row additive-Schwarz mechanism without changing parity, order, fraction, block solve, coefficient, preconditioner, parent, depth, controls or thresholds. Do not train or rent a GPU to rescue it.
